outcome: Association between LBW and cesarean delivery
cohort: 393 children with Congenital Zika Syndrome (CZS) living in Bahia, Brazil, from 2015-2017
finding: The prevalence of low birth weight (LBW) was very high among children with CZS, both for those born preterm and term/post-term, and was associated with prematurity and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Children born by cesarean section had a 1.63 higher probability of presenting LBW than those born by vaginal delivery, after adjusting for gestational age at birth.
